correctness.rationale: For each hypersimplex vertex, every integral cone point decomposes as a nonnegative sum of elementary swaps, giving exactly the rank-one k-by-(n-k) determinantal coordinate ring. It has no singular nonzero matrices. Direct bound saturation classifies every perturbed vertex. The n-1 signed coordinate normals omitting the unique free coordinate form an integral basis, proving both fans smooth. Greedy optimization for all generic weight vectors proves both normal fans refine the original; no new rays means no exceptional divisors. Their local fan patterns agree with the standard row- and column-line incidence resolutions, giving exactly the asserted exceptional projective-space fibers. The sole ray relation gives the exact Gorenstein boundary, and the fiber inequality proves the selected intersection-homological small map. CHECKER.py tested 42 full vertex-enumeration cases with exact rational numbers; finite checks were not substituted for the proof. The local cone correspondence is checked via explicit incidence affine coordinates a_h=u_h/u_i and b_j=u_i v_j; their character exponents reproduce exactly the n-1 rays of the perturbed fan.

originality.rationale: The contribution is the explicit coherent global pair of projective smooth no-new-ray refinements, together with both fiber descriptions, their perverse-small orientation and crepant threshold. Jojić proves shellings and toric h-vectors, and Wang--Yu proves intersection-cohomology ranks, so those invariants and local rank-one incidence resolutions are excluded from the novelty claim. The Cox--Little--Schenck general toric resolution machinery does not itself specify this two-sided uniform-matroid box-slice construction or prove its Delzant and fiber properties. No matched published-finding corpus item or published result found to imply the complete global statement; an unindexed equivalent refinement remains the stated substantive residual risk. A prior computation on exactly the same generic Grassmannian torus-orbit closure gives degree and Euler characteristic but does not imply the pair of resolution morphisms; this establishes object overlap without claim subsumption.
residual_risks: An unindexed earlier globalization or coherent hypersimplex fan-refinement statement, possibly under the terminology of matroid toric varieties or unimodular subdivisions, may exist despite negative targeted searches.

The known polar-hypersimplex shelling and unimodular triangulation results significantly narrow novelty: this finding claims the two explicit rational box-slice refinements with projective maps and exceptional fibers, not numerical toric h-vectors.
An independent proof and novelty audit has not been performed.

value.rationale: A singular infinite family of generic Grassmannian torus-orbit closures admits two simultaneous smooth projective *small* resolutions, with explicitly different exceptional dimensions and an exactly determined perverse-small choice. This is a concrete birational-geometric construction, not a known-table or formula recomputation. The central Gorenstein/crepant case gives explicit pairs of small crepant models; the noncentral case exposes a sharp non-Q-Gorenstein obstruction. The natural singularity model and exceptional fiber geometry are usable for studying derived/perverse invariants and wall crossings, independently of the already established IH Betti formulas.
